fix_commit_message:
[maglev types] Bail out earlier if we end up with an impossible type in CheckMaps

This avoids problems in generating dead code (esp write barriers).

agent_reasoning: Merged diff composed mechanically by cherry-picking fix b04613a41917 on top of intro ce7082ea1d46 via git's 3-way merge. Vulnerability (LogicError):  Root cause: The introducing commit correctly tightened the type semantics by returning EmptyNodeType() for an empty map intersection, but the caller (BuildCheckMaps) was not updated to detect and handle the case where the combined type of the merger result and the object becomes empty (impossible). Without this guard, dead-code paths are emitted with type invariants that write-barrier elision code cannot satisfy.
